changes: Replaces per-request localhost SAB HTTP teardown with one serialized persistent HTTP/1.1 control connection while preserving the existing single-filed request lock.
Reopens the private SAB control connection automatically after genuine transport faults, listener replacement, port changes, long idle intervals, or server-requested connection closure.
Adds SAB HTTP transport diagnostics for total requests, opened/reused connections, reuse percentage, reconnects, transport resets, server closes, idle reopens, and resets grouped by SAB API mode.
Preserves v3.6.28 durable Downloads visibility continuity as an independent safety layer instead of weakening or replacing it.
Preserves v3.6.28 clean-generation recovery rules, v3.6.27 adapter identity validation, v3.6.26 verified Remove/bulk Failed cleanup, and v3.6.25 Smart Import safeguards.
regression_guards: All NewzDeck-to-SAB API traffic remains serialized through the existing re-entrant transport lock; persistent connection reuse never introduces overlapping control requests.
HTTP 401/403 and SAB JSON API-key errors remain authentication failures and continue through the existing authoritative identity-reconciliation path rather than being counted as transport resets.
Any transport exception invalidates the persistent client connection before existing bounded retry/reconciliation logic runs.
v3.6.28 visibility continuity and fresh Queue+History absence rules remain unchanged.
Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server v0.3.3 integration, installer/updater behavior, provider settings, and user data preservation are otherwise unchanged.
name: Persistent SAB Control Transport
